dedupe_keys.name: data set for evacuation network design and planning under traffic congestion

description: Data set for Evacuation Network Design and Planning under Traffic Congestion is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Alfredo Moreno, Valérie Bélanger (HEC Montreal). This dataset contains instances that can be used to validate and test the Evacuation Network Design and Planning Problem under Traffic Congestion. A total of 144 networks were generated, with different topologies, areas, and source and destination nodes location. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
